name: Pipeliners - OTTO Fix List 2026-07-14
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-07-14

# Summary
A dashboard fix list for items OTTO injects (not stored in WordPress), dated 2026-07-14, with steps to reach each field in Search Atlas OTTO.

# Items
- **Weak H1s:** /tempe/, /scottsdale/ and /sun-city/ had bare city names (Sun City with a double space); set to "Trenchless Pipe Repair in <City>, AZ | Pipeliners USA".
- **Peoria:** broken divider character in the H1 and a dated "in 2025" title.
- **Stale schema:** Peoria, Glendale and Litchfield Park still carried the old boilerplate Service description ("refined method for rectifying"); city-specific replacements provided. Spot-check 9 other rewritten pages.
- Order: H1s, then schema, then spot checks, then redeploy and verify.

# Note
The proposed H1s end in "| Pipeliners USA", which the later naming rule replaces with "Pipeliners". OTTO later took over all titles and H1s and the city pages were reworked many times.
